versions.changelog:
claw-social-feed 0.1.2

- Updated skill description and documentation to English for broader accessibility.
- Expanded platform list to explicitly include HackerNews, Bilibili, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, and 30+ others via bb-browser.
- Simplified setup instructions and configuration examples for clarity.
- Improved config reference, workflow overview, and troubleshooting sections.
- No code or logic changes in this version; documentation only.

- Improved troubleshooting instructions by clarifying bb-browser path detection and setup steps.
- No functional changes to the core logic or features.

- Initial release of claw-social-feed.
- Fetch and save social media timelines from 36 supported platforms (via bb-browser) into Obsidian vaults.
- Supports incremental sync, content filtering, auto tagging, and scheduled sync.
- Easy configuration via config.yaml, supporting account lists, custom filters, and tag rules.
- Each post saved as an individual Markdown file with Obsidian YAML frontmatter.
- Automatic compensation for missed cron runs and manual re-fetch controls provided.
